timing_join_reaudit.method: For every node and each finalized height1..64, anchor to its unique decision_durable_ack; require candidate_execution_done, candidate_registered, every recorded proposal/QC/staged/projection event to have the same body_id and round; every non-null value must equal the ACK's candidate statement hash. CandidateRegistered bridges body ID to checked-statement hash.

field_semantics.body: Canonical candidate input body ID. It is not the statement digest and not the NovoRUDP wire fragment ID.
field_semantics.value: Checked candidate statement hash / consensus proposal value. CandidateExecutionDone records no value, so registration supplies the body-to-statement association.
field_semantics.delivery_fragment: Wire-object identity in native_delivery; do not equate this with critical_path.body or critical_path.value.

source_references.proof: Execution records the original body-map key; registration receives the same id and completed DurableCandidate.
Lookahead execution records work.id in body; remains subject to eventual promotion and registration.
Registration checks owner/context/parent, derives value=statement.hash(), requires an existing value's body identity to remain equal, then records both fields.
Proposal and QC records keep proposal.value in value and offered body_id in body.
Journal ACK uses decided proposal value to look up candidate.body_id, recording the same association.
JSON exports value and body independently without swapping their meaning.

timing_join_reaudit.timing_conclusion: The reported node0 height1 execution-to-proposal1143.5129ms and height48 execution-to-precommit1187.0075ms join the same eventual body, round0 and registered consensus value. No measurement values need correction. Missing proposal events remain missing, not zero latency. Matching identity proves the timing join, not its root cause.

stage_quantile_definition: Nearest-rank quantiles over recorded local-node height transitions; 256 node-height samples except parent intervals (252). Timings are inclusive and overlap. They are not CPU utilization or additive TPS phase costs.
findings: This diagnostic round passes 65536 receipts, all economics and cold recovery; it does not reproduce the prior 17.325802-second P99. 1967.186090 TPS and 4.890358-second P99 are diagnostic observations, not replacement primary scores.

All 256 finalized node-height records remain round0. Earliest clear progress skew is height1: node0 executes at local982.8212ms, receives the proposal at2126.3341ms (1143.5129ms later). Other nodes complete their first candidate near that later point. Height2 ACK intervals are approximately935-950ms, and height3 approximately972-1015ms.

Across local node-height samples, precommit-QC-to-ACK P50/P95/P99/max are1.9473/39.5297/101.5116/102.1469ms. ACK-to-receipt-projection P50/P95/P99/max are2.1759/4.1697/5.7709/5.9884ms. This sample does not show multi-second journal or projection delay; most long intervals precede candidate/QC availability.

Height48 makes the split visible: node0 already executes and sees proposal, then waits1187.0075ms from execution to precommit QC; node2 and node3 finish their own execution much later. Node1 receives a recovery body, finishes execution73.38ms later, and gets its ACK1.89ms after execution. Event proximity does not identify the last quorum vote or prove votes were not buffered.

Height48 node1 receives the same body fragment from three peers. The second and third deliveries are176.32ms and413.785ms AFTER its local ACK. Redundant application receipt after finalization is directly observed, but the record does not prove those copies all caused new crypto work.

Multiple recovery_owned events for one sender/peer/fragment are not automatically multiple sends: e.g. height48 node0-to45f8 peer has two owned events but one admitted event, with the second owned event following decision-DONE body continuation. Existing delivery coalescing is active in that case.

Full-run strict signature rows are65536/82944/70656/74752 and prepare-reused rows65536/45056/59392/55296; batch calls64/81/69/73. Unlike the small4K sample, this long sample contains extra strict work at nodes1-3. These aggregate counters do not alone attribute all extra work to one duplicate body or recovery branch.

requested_bodies3/150/50/43 and served_bodies152/102/134/133 are queue/owner counters, not physical transmissions. All native expired-send counters are zero. Recovery/body traffic coincides with progress skew, but correlation is not a complete causal explanation.

Critical timeline is complete (zero dropped). Delivery rings retain only2048 events per node and evicted3584/2810/2891/2883; earliest retained delivery heights are40/37/37/37. Exact height1-3 request/body responsibility cannot be reconstructed from this final ring.

No source was edited, build or benchmark launched, database opened, timeout changed, or key/config copied. The31MB observations file remains at the original path; report plus compact stage/recovery evidence are sufficient for this audit.
